global_summary: A practical automotive tutorial demonstrating how to use a portable tire repair kit to fix a flat tire, presented by the consumer review organization Which?. The video follows a man driving a white car through autumn-leaf-strewn roads, then parking to inspect a tire, apply sealant, and use a portable compressor to reinflate it. It includes interior shots of dashboard controls, explanations of the process, and ends with driving scenes and a promotional offer for Which? services.
reason: The video is a step-by-step instructional guide on tire repair, heavily focused on demonstrating tools and procedures (technical_expert). It emphasizes hands-on, actionable skills for roadside emergencies (practical_expert). The consistent autumn driving scenes and clear shot compositions support the tutorial (visual_expert), while the driving segments and promotional tie-in provide light context (narrative_expert).
